headline: On Amazon US the 2026 calendar sits in the wrong category and has almost no ad support, in the biggest weeks of the year for a search with 3.8 million monthly searches.

points.title: Move the 2026 calendar out of Home Décor
points.detail: On amazon.com the 2026 calendar is listed under Home & Kitchen > Home Décor Products, while last year's edition sits in Seasonal Décor > Advent Calendars and the UK listing is in Make-up Sets. The wrong category hurts its rank and how Amazon matches it to calendar shoppers.
evidence: B0GTRFKFV5 (US): Home & Kitchen > Home Décor Products, sales rank #6,663 (Keepa)
B09RKF8DQK 2025 edition (US): Home & Kitchen > Seasonal Décor > Advent Calendars

points.title: Put ad support behind it
points.detail: Only 1 of its top 30 searches has a W7 ad, and that one is 'stocking stuffers for teens'. It ranks #3 for 'beauty advent calendar' (66.8k/mo) and #6 for 'beauty advent calendar 2026' (99.4k/mo) with nothing behind it, right in peak season.
evidence: Sponsored coverage: 1 of top 30 keywords (Jungle Scout)
beauty advent calendar 2026: 99,424/mo, organic #6, no sponsored rank
beauty advent calendar: 66,752/mo, organic #3, no sponsored rank
amazon beauty advent calendar 2026: 73,498/mo, organic #7, no sponsored rank

points.title: Go after 'advent calendar 2026'
points.detail: 'Advent calendar 2026' gets 3.8 million searches a month and the calendar sits at #35. A top-of-search campaign, alongside the category fix, is the quickest way onto page one in the next eight weeks.
evidence: advent calendar 2026: 3,848,176/mo, organic #35, no sponsored rank

hero_actions.B0GTRFKFV5: Fix the category, then run top-of-search ads on the 'beauty advent calendar' terms and 'advent calendar 2026'.

content_note: Strong content (7 zoomable images, phone-friendly A+, 5,300+ reviews at 4.4★). The gaps are the category and the advertising.
ad_strategy_summary: Fix the category, then fund the beauty advent calendar terms where it already ranks in the top 10, and test 'advent calendar 2026' at top of search.
amc_hypotheses: Most US calendar buyers will be new to W7, which makes the calendar a cheap way to win new customers for the wider range.
amc_questions: How many US calendar buyers are new to the brand?
Do they go on to buy W7 make-up on Amazon US?
